create_SingleSpike: create a SingleSpike object with a datetime, value, and n_sigma for spike tracking
create_ChangePointInterval: create a ChangePointInterval with start and end times then set data and detect spikes
create_PercentageChange: create a PercentageChange object from two ChangePointInterval instances to compute t-scores and p-values
create_AnomalyResponse: create an AnomalyResponse with scores, confidence bands, predicted time series, and anomaly magnitude
create_ConfidenceBand: create a ConfidenceBand dataclass with lower and upper TimeSeriesData for anomaly detection bounds
